places.name: Lorena's camp
places.note: Blue Duck slips in at night, ties Lorena to her saddle and leads her away.
places.location_hint: east of the Hat Creek herd's bed-ground; the cow camp lay to the west

places.name: Hat Creek outfit's cow camp
places.note: Blue Duck rides with his captive straight through the stampeding herd without being seen.

places.name: Blue Duck's route through empty hill country
places.note: Several days of hard riding through empty rocky ridges, crossing many creeks, while horses give out and Lorena suffers thirst.
places.location_hint: rough, empty country crossed by many creeks, travelled several days and nights from the herd; trees thinning as they go

places.name: Stream where Blue Duck rested
places.note: After a full night and day riding, they stop here until dark; Lorena finally drinks and Blue Duck threatens her.
places.location_hint: about a day's hard ride beyond the herd, through rocky ridge country

places.name: Red-sand river crossing
places.note: Wide riverbed of boggy reddish sand with a thin brown stream; Ermoke and three renegades wait on the far side.
places.location_hint: several days' ride from the herd, where the country flattens into tall grass and long views

places.name: Grassland beyond the sand river
places.note: Past the river the party stops at sundown and Ermoke's men assault Lorena before riding on by moonlight.
places.location_hint: flat tall-grass country a short ride beyond the red-sand river crossing

places.name: Austin
places.note: Lorena supposes Jake is still there playing cards.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Lorena despairs of ever seeing it.

groups.label: Blue Duck's party with Lorena
groups.hint: a short ride past a broad red-sand river, several days from the herd, waiting for moonrise
